message: The other day, I was in the kitchen, trying to whip up a quick dinner, when I remembered the fire safety talk we had with the kids last month. Instead of just going over escape plans, we ended up having a fun little family game where we pretended to be firefighters! 🚒 It was such a hit that we just might make it a monthly thing. Sometimes, rediscovering low-tech fun can help us learn important lessons while making great memories. What’s your favorite way to blend safety with fun at home?
